sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To say “you” (informal *te*), add *-sz* to the stem: *tanul* becomes *tanulsz*. There is no choice of vowel here: *-sz* is the same whatever the vowels of the stem are. You already know it from *laksz*, “you live”.

A statement and a yes/no question use the same words. In speech your voice goes up at the end of the question, and in writing you add *?*: *Tanulsz.* means “You study.” and *Tanulsz?* means “Do you study?”
